double evaluate(int m, int n) {
    ll total = (ll)n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 6;
    double favorable = 0.0;
    if (m >= 3) favorable += (ll)m * (m - 1) * (m - 2) / 6.0;
    if (m >= 2) favorable += (ll)m * (m - 1) / 2.0 * (n - m);
    if (m >= 1 && n - m >= 2) favorable += 0.5 * m * (ll)(n - m) * (n - m - 1) / 2.0;
    return favorable / total;
}

        double prob = evaluate(mid, n);
        if (prob >= p) right = mid;
        else left = mid + 1;
    }
    cout << left << endl;
}
